scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit village marketplace, a traveler in worn clothing holds out a small purse to a seated merchant. Behind them, a man in red gestures while speaking to another man at a stall.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative marketplace scene reflects the proverb’s contrast between a poor person walking in integrity and a fool whose speech is perverse.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A startled traveler in a cream tunic and red-brown cloak stumbles on a rocky hillside path, with a smoother path winding behind him through a sunlit landscape.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures the verse’s warning about acting without knowledge and hastening with one’s feet.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A frustrated traveler among thorny branches on a rocky hillside path raises one hand toward the sky; a clear road winds through the valley below.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene reflecting Proverbs 19:3: a person’s foolishness twists his way while his heart frets against Yahweh.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit village marketplace, four smiling companions gather around a richly dressed man holding a purse. Nearby, a poor man in worn clothing reaches toward a man who turns away with a raised hand.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene expressing Proverbs 19:4: wealth brings many friends, while the poor are separated from a friend.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A worried man gestures before three seated elders at a stone town gate while another man watches; a sunlit town and hills appear beyond the open gateway.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of a witness facing the elders evokes the proverb’s warning that a false witness and speaker of lies will not escape accountability.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A seated nobleman in purple offers a small red gift pouch as smiling townspeople gather around him in a sunlit stone courtyard; a basket of wrapped gifts rests on his lap.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of people seeking a nobleman's favor and gathering around a giver of gifts, reflecting Proverbs 19:6.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A man in worn, patched clothing sits on a stone wall and reaches toward four figures walking away along a sunlit village path.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene reflecting Proverbs 19:7: a poor man appeals as others turn away and leave him.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: An older teacher speaks to a young learner who tends a fruiting fig tree beside a spring in a sunlit hillside garden.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative garden scene suggests receiving and keeping wisdom and understanding, and finding good, as in Proverbs 19:8.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A worried man gestures before three seated elders at a stone town gate, with a spear-bearing guard behind him and a withered tree beside a distant path.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene represents Proverbs 19:9’s warning that a false witness will not go unpunished and one who speaks lies will perish.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit palace courtyard, a richly dressed man reclines among cushions and a lavish feast, holding grapes and a cup. Nearby, a plainly dressed man gestures toward seated, richly dressed princes, who look up at him.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene illustrating Proverbs 19:10, which contrasts luxury for a fool with a servant ruling over princes.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit village courtyard, a seated man reaches out gently to a distressed kneeling person beside a broken earthenware jar and spilled water.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures the patient restraint and overlooking of an offense described in Proverbs 19:11.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A crowned king seated on a palace terrace extends a hand toward a kneeling visitor. A lion roars from a rocky rise beyond the garden, while dew glistens on foreground grass in the dawn light.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene illustrating the verse's comparison of a king's wrath to a lion's roar and his favor to dew on grass.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: In a rustic home, a weary seated father rests his head in his hand beside spilled grain and broken pottery. A downcast young man stands nearby as a woman speaks to the father; drops from the roof fall into a bowl.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene reflecting the foolish son's ruin for his father and the comparison of a wife's contentions to continual dripping in Proverbs 19:13.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, a woman holding wheat gestures toward stored grain while a man listens; an older man stands beside an open chest of valuables near the house.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene for Proverbs 19:14, suggesting a father's material inheritance and the gift of a prudent wife from Yahweh.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A man sleeps beneath a tree beside a dry, overgrown garden, with an empty earthenware bowl in the foreground and a village beyond.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of deep sleep and an empty bowl suggests the proverb's link between laziness, sleep, and hunger.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A traveler carries a closed scroll along a sunlit stone path while another traveler heads toward a crumbling cliff; olive trees, flowers, hills, and a village fill the landscape.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene contrasting the person who keeps the commandment and preserves his life with the danger faced by one careless of his ways in Proverbs 19:16.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A villager kneels beside an elderly traveler on a sunlit stone path, sharing a loaf of bread and holding a water jug. Olive trees, fields, and a village lie behind them.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of kindness to a poor traveler, reflecting Proverbs 19:17's promise that the Lord regards and repays generosity to the poor.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A father sits beside his young son in a sunlit stone village, resting a hand on his shoulder and gesturing toward a path as the boy looks up at him; a green sapling grows nearby.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of a father guiding his son with hope and restraint, reflecting Proverbs 19:18.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit village pottery market, a concerned man pulls back an angry man with clenched fists while a distressed merchant sits beside shattered clay pots; more intact pots stand nearby.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene reflects Proverbs 19:19: anger brings consequences, and rescuing an angry person can become a repeated task.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: An older man gestures as he speaks to a younger man seated beside him beneath an olive tree. A winding path leads past trees and stone buildings toward sunlit hills.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene evokes listening to counsel and receiving instruction, with the distant path suggesting wisdom in later days.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A thoughtful man in a cream robe stands beside a large olive tree, looking over branching paths that wind through a sunlit valley toward distant villages and hills.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene suggesting the many plans in a person's heart and the enduring counsel of Yahweh in Proverbs 19:21.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A plainly dressed man shares a loaf of bread with a seated traveler on a sunlit village street, while a richly dressed merchant holds an open pouch nearby.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene reflects Proverbs 19:22's value of kindness and its contrast between a poor person and a liar.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A man sits with his hands joined and head bowed outside a stone home at sunset. Bread, fruit and a lit oil lamp rest beside him, a dog sleeps at his feet, and a fig tree and flowering garden overlook distant hills and rain clouds.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of reverence, provision and peaceful rest reflecting Proverbs 19:23.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A reclining man in a sunlit stone courtyard rests his head on one hand while the other lies in a bowl of food on a low table. Bread, fruit, pottery, patterned cushions, and vines surround him.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene illustrating Proverbs 19:24, where a lazy man puts his hand in a bowl but does not bring it back to his mouth.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, an elder speaks earnestly to a seated man who listens thoughtfully. Behind them, a young onlooker watches warily as a man raises a stick toward another man recoiling.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene reflecting Proverbs 19:25: a simple observer becomes wary at a scoffer's chastening, while a person of understanding listens to correction.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, an angry man clutches a chest and other belongings while pointing toward the open gate. An elderly man recoils beside him, and an elderly woman walks away through the gate, looking back.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene reflects Proverbs 19:26, in which a son mistreats his father, drives away his mother, and brings shame and reproach.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A father gestures toward a young man turning away from him onto a rocky, overgrown hillside path; a clear road, village, lake and mountains lie behind them.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of a son turning away from instruction and straying, inspired by Proverbs 19:27.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: At a stone town gate, a smiling man gestures dismissively toward seated elders while an anxious man watches and another man bites a dark fruit.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative town-gate hearing depicts a witness scorning justice; the fruit is a visual metaphor for the wicked devouring iniquity.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, a stern seated judge points toward a defiant man standing with his back partly turned. An attendant nearby holds a lowered rod.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative court scene evokes the judgments prepared for scoffers and the blows for the backs of fools in Proverbs 19:29.
